items.html: It is also called ‘a tower flying in the air,’ which is the phase of the Lamed itself. Now, it is suspended and held in the first phase, called air, and this is ‘a tower flying in the air.’ For you already know that the letter Lamed is called ‘a tower flying in the air,’ as stated in the Zohar, portion Yitro. This is the phase of this Lamed of Tzelem, which is the NHY of the third Tevuna. Understand this.
